```yaml
name: i18n Check
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled ]

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Run i18n checks
        run: |
          mvn clean compile
          # Add your specific i18n validation commands here
          # Example: check for missing translations, incorrect message formats, etc.
          echo "Running internationalization checks..."
          
      - name: Validate translation completeness
        run: |
          # Check for any untranslated strings or missing resources
          find . -name "*.properties" -exec grep -l ".*=.*" {} \; | xargs grep -L ".*=.*" | wc -l
          
      - name: Report issues
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Internationalization issues detected!"
          exit 1
```
